prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity generated concept image for the in-game interface of Homestead Tycoon: Luna Landing, a cozy Roblox autumn farming game. Single landscape 16:9 gameplay screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher with that ratio. This is a UI design mockup of the SEED SELECTION state, not a poster, presentation, collage, annotated design sheet, or real implemented screenshot.

SCENE: Third-person gameplay camera looking slightly downward from behind a modest Roblox-proportioned gardener toward a low timber planting bed. A small cream plaster cottage with russet roof and dark timber beams stands back left, cream gravel paths, rich deep green grass, low timber fencing, simple layered faceted autumn trees in ochre/russet/evergreen, pale distant polygon mountains, blue sky. Broad simple shapes, matte lightly textured surfaces, believable achievable Roblox environment, restrained warm afternoon daylight. Some established faceted pepper plants with bright red fruit occupy one part of the bed; one empty soil slot is subtly outlined with a clean cream ring for seed selection. The character and bed remain completely visible, slightly left of center. Keep environment sharp and visible, NO scene-wide darkening, blur, vignette, huge signs, or cinematic haze.

PRIMARY DESIGN: Extremely clean, less-is-more UI. Very few components, generous breathing space, LARGE easy-to-read icons and numerals, warm cream surfaces, deep forest-green text, rounded corners, subtle soft shadows. Colorful deliberately faceted 3D item art with crisp silhouettes, not glossy inflated plastic. Small overall UI footprint while individual controls remain large. At least 80 percent of the full screen is unobstructed game world. NO screen-spanning panels, NO sidebar, NO giant inventory menu.

HUD:
- Top right with comfortable margins: a compact cream rounded capsule with a large muted brass OCTAGONAL coin featuring an inset five-point star, and bold deep-green number "248". No currency name.
- Bottom center: one slim row of FIVE separate comfortably spaced cream rounded-square buttons, each around 80-90 pixels at 1920 width. Icon art fills each button generously. In order: shovel, green watering can, kraft seed packet with a big red pepper pictogram, simple fertilizer sack with leaf pictogram, simple satchel bag. Seed packet button is selected with a deep-green border and slight raised position. A large "12" quantity badge on that seed button; fertilizer has a large "8" badge. Absolutely no permanent words underneath the tools, no numbered keyboard key hints, no other toolbar.
- Seed choice popup near the empty bed slot on the right side, around x=1260 y=470 width=470 height=275 in a 1920x1080 frame, positioned so it does NOT cover the bed or player and is NOT attached to the screen edge. A compact cream rounded rectangle, modest shadow, header "Seeds" in large bold forest-green text, a comfortably large × at upper right. Four large packet choices in a SINGLE row: red pepper, carrot, lettuce, pumpkin. Each is a kraft paper packet with one large colorful crop pictogram and NO lettering or printed numerals on the packet. Beneath each packet, separate bold deep-green UI quantity: "12", "6", "8", "4". The pepper tile has a green selected outline and a simple check indicator. Below the row show only the large word "Pepper" for the currently focused item. No other description, buttons, or price. All four items must be individually recognizable at full frame size. Packet pictures should occupy most of the popup, not vast empty padding.
- A simple mouse pointer is over the pepper choice. This is a choice state; do not show an active E world-action prompt competing with the picker.

TYPE: Use a friendly clean rounded sans serif with substantial weight. Every label and numeral is conspicuously readable: around 28-36px at 1920 width. No thin small lettering anywhere. Only written strings anywhere in the image: "248", "Seeds", "12", "6", "8", "4", "Pepper", the fertilizer quantity "8", and ×. Counts are UI overlays, never baked into item artwork.

DO NOT ADD: title/logo, mockup labels, explanatory text, annotation arrows, miniature subpanels, tutorials, quest lists, health/energy bars, minimap, chat, Roblox Studio editor chrome, developer controls, sale menu, progress bars all over crops, sparkling magic, watermarks, wood-framed panels, textured paper UI, heavy outlines around every icon, thick ornamental borders. Focus on a satisfying clean game interface the user can judge visually. Make the UI exceptionally crisp and polished; keep the background recognizably simple low-poly Roblox.

Use case: precise-object-edit / reusable game UI sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the accepted Luna Landing seed-selection UI concept. Extract and extend ONLY its UI item artwork into a reusable transparent sprite atlas. Replace the entire scene, avatar, text, UI panels, shadows behind panels, badges and counts with transparent background. Recreate the same packet, trowel, green watering can, fertilizer sack, brown satchel and octagonal star coin art as closely as possible. This sheet is one production texture for the game's interface, not a concept poster.

OUTPUT: exactly one PNG with true transparent alpha background, portrait 2:3 ratio, ideally 1024x1536. EXACT regular grid FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, total 24 icons. Each cell same size, 256x256 at 1024x1536. NO grid lines, backgrounds, labels, text, numerals, arrows, captions, shadows outside an icon, or decorative separators. Each complete icon is centered within its own cell with ample transparent gutters. Keep each icon fully inside the central 76% of its cell; no clipping, overlap, objects touching cell boundaries, or items straddling cells. Cell centers x = 128,384,640,896; cell centers y =128,384,640,896,1152,1408. Layout must be evenly spaced and mechanically regular for sprite extraction.

EXACT contents reading left-to-right row by row:
ROW 1: pepper seed packet; carrot seed packet; lettuce seed packet; pumpkin seed packet.
ROW 2: grape seed packet; corn seed packet; wheat seed packet; potato seed packet.
ROW 3: loose red bell pepper; loose orange carrot with short green leaves; loose green lettuce head; loose orange pumpkin with green-brown curved stem.
ROW 4: purple grape bunch; golden corn cob with small green husk; tied small golden wheat bundle; two tan potatoes together.
ROW 5: planting shovel/trowel with brown wooden handle and gray steel blade; deep-green metal watering can; kraft fertilizer sack with a simple green leaf pictogram; brown leather satchel/backpack.
ROW 6: matte brass octagonal coin with inset five-point star; closed honey-brown timber house storage chest with simple dark metal bands and clasp; same chest open with an empty dark interior; friendly cream gardening hand icon shown palm-up.

PACKETS: Same front-facing slightly dimensional warm kraft packet silhouette as in the input's seed popup, fold at top. One LARGE colorful crop picture centered on packet. Absolutely NO printed writing of any kind, NO seeds word, NO numbers. Pepper, carrot, lettuce and pumpkin packets closely match the input. Extend that same visual language to grapes, corn, wheat, potatoes. Consistent packet proportions and scale across all eight.
PRODUCE: Match corresponding crop pictograms, larger detached objects, no packet or tile behind. Strong recognizable shapes, soft deliberate facets and minimal fine texture.
TOOLS AND CHESTS: Match the warm polished 3D UI icon finish in the concept, clean bold silhouettes and restrained material detail. Chests must look like practical farm storage, not treasure chests: flat/slightly rounded rectangular lid, squat timber box, no jewels, gold trim or writing.
LIGHTING: consistent upper-left soft light, mild baked contact shading only inside each object, no big drop shadows.
The background must be actual alpha transparency, not a checkerboard picture. No text anywhere. Keep all 24 cells occupied by exactly their specified icon. The icons must be usable at 80-120px in the game.

Use case: ui-mockup / edit of the accepted game UI concept.
Input image 1 is the accepted Luna Landing UI concept. Create a second single landscape 16:9 concept showing interaction with a HOUSE CHEST using exactly the same cream/deep-green UI styling, bold large rounded type, colorful 3D icons, and five-button bottom tool row. Preserve the same cozy low-poly autumn art direction and same gardener identity. Change the gameplay camera to the cottage porch, where a simple squat wooden storage chest with dark iron straps sits against the wall. Its lid is open. The gardener stands beside it. Farm and autumn scenery remain visible behind, no full-screen darkening, no blur.

Replace the Seeds popup with ONE compact cream chest popup in the right half, about 600px wide by 470px tall in a 1920x1080 frame. It should occupy at most 20 percent of the screen, with lots of visible world around it. It is NOT a full-height sidebar and NOT two huge inventory panels. Large typography, large icons, no tiny text.
Popup header: small open-chest icon then large title "Chest", large × on the right.
Inside, a 2x3 grid of SIX big rounded slots: top row purple grapes with count "6", loose pumpkins with count "3", carrot seed packet with count "9"; bottom row loose potatoes with count "8", then TWO empty subtle outlined slots. All icon art has no text baked into it. One small distinct silver diamond quality badge overlays the grape stack, never color alone.
Below the grid, a slim review row: red-pepper seed packet, a large count "12", a simple right-pointing arrow, small chest icon. At right a big green action button labeled "Store". This represents the selected whole hotbar stack moving into the chest, not already moved. Below/alongside it one smaller but still comfortably large secondary button labeled "Amount". No long explanation, no redundant item name.
A cream world prompt near the physical chest says "E" in a keycap and "Chest"; show it subdued while the chest popup has focus.
Keep the bottom tool row just like image 1: shovel, can, pepper packet selected count "12", fertilizer count "8", brown bag. Top-right coin capsule reads "248". Do not draw duplicate full inventory bars or tiny keyboard shortcut numbers.
The visual must make it clear the selected hotbar stack can be stored in the chest while the world stays visible. Only short labels "Chest", "Store", "Amount", input glyph "E", quantities, "248", and ×. NO other prose or annotations. No artwork text on packets, no app/editor chrome, no watermarks. This is a polished UI concept, not a fake implemented screenshot.

Edit the input image ONLY to remove ALL the 2D screen UI overlays. Remove the entire cream Chest panel on the right including its contents, the top right coin/248 capsule, all five bottom toolbar buttons and their icons, and the E Chest prompt near the physical chest. Reconstruct the underlying world seamlessly. Preserve the exact image dimensions, camera, cottage porch, open empty wooden chest, gardener identity, clothing, pose and location, lighting, autumn landscaping, fence, lake, mountains and existing scene composition. This will be a clean backdrop for a functional UI prototype. No words, symbols, icons, toolbars or screen overlays of any kind. No new objects. Keep the actual physical open wooden chest.
